pool_config.pool_brief: Build an interactive DOM manipulation page for a Nigerian tech context. Your solution must use: getElementById and querySelector/querySelectorAll, textContent and innerHTML, setAttribute/getAttribute, classList (add, remove, toggle), inline styles via element.style, and Array.from with NodeList iteration. All variables must use const or let.

projects.title: Konga Product Listing Page
projects.scenario: Build a dynamic product listing page for a Konga store. Use JavaScript to populate product cards, update prices, manage stock badges, and show an availability alert.
requirements: Select the element with id 'page-title' and update its textContent to 'Konga Store — Electronics'
Use querySelectorAll to select all '.product-card' elements (at least 3 in HTML); log the count
Use forEach on the NodeList to log each card's data-name attribute (use getAttribute)
Select the first card's '.card-price' element using querySelector on the card element; update its textContent to '₦4,500'
Use classList.add to add 'in-stock' to the first card and classList.add('out-of-stock') to the last card
Use classList.toggle to toggle a 'highlighted' class on the first card; log whether it contains 'highlighted'
Select the element with id 'stock-alert', update its textContent, and use classList.remove to remove the 'hidden' class
Use Array.from on the NodeList of product cards and use filter to keep cards that do not contain the 'out-of-stock' class; log the filtered count

projects.title: Publica Academy Course Dashboard
projects.scenario: Build a course dashboard for a Publica Academy student. Use JavaScript to populate course info, show enrolment status, manage a progress bar, and reveal a confirmation message.
requirements: Select the element with id 'student-name' and update its textContent to a student name of your choice
Use querySelector to select '.course-title' and update its textContent to 'JavaScript Fundamentals — Module 10'
Use setAttribute to set the 'data-enrolled' attribute on the element with id 'course-card' to 'true'; log it back with getAttribute
Use element.style to set the width of id 'progress-fill' to '72%' and backgroundColor to 'navy'
Use querySelectorAll to select all '.module-badge' elements; log the count, then use forEach to log each badge's textContent
Use classList.remove to remove 'hidden' from the element with id 'enrol-confirm'
Use classList.toggle on the element with id 'alert-box' to toggle the 'hidden' class; log whether it contains 'hidden'
Use Array.from on the module badges NodeList and use filter to count only badges containing 'Passed'; log that count

projects.title: PiggyVest Savings Dashboard
projects.scenario: Build a savings dashboard for a PiggyVest user. Use JavaScript to display account info, update a savings progress bar, manage transaction badges, and toggle notifications.
requirements: Select the element with id 'account-owner' and update its textContent to an account owner name
Use querySelector to select '.balance-display' and update its textContent to '₦18,000 saved'
Use element.style to set the width of id 'savings-bar' to '36%' and backgroundColor to '#28a745'
Use setAttribute to set 'data-goal' attribute on id 'savings-card' to '50000'; log it with getAttribute
Use querySelectorAll to select all '.transaction-row' elements; log the count and use forEach to log each one's textContent
Use classList.add to add 'active' to the element with id 'savings-tab'
Use classList.toggle to toggle 'hidden' on id 'notification-box'; log contains 'hidden' result
Use Array.from on the transaction rows and filter to keep only rows whose textContent includes 'deposit'; log the filtered count

projects.title: Paystack Transaction Dashboard
projects.scenario: Build a merchant transaction dashboard for a Paystack business. Use JavaScript to display revenue stats, manage transaction badges, update a revenue bar, and toggle status messages.
requirements: Select the element with id 'merchant-name' and update its textContent to a business name
Use innerHTML to set the content of id 'revenue-display' to '₦240,000 total revenue'
Use element.style to set the width of id 'revenue-bar' to '80%' and backgroundColor to 'navy'
Use setAttribute to set 'data-period' attribute on id 'stats-card' to 'January 2025'; log it with getAttribute
Use querySelectorAll to select all '.txn-badge' elements; log the count and use forEach to log each badge's textContent
Use classList.remove to remove 'hidden' from id 'success-banner'
Use classList.toggle 'hidden' on id 'warning-box'; log whether it contains 'hidden' after the toggle
Use Array.from on the txn badges and filter to keep badges whose textContent includes 'success'; log the count

projects.title: Bolt Driver Earnings Page
projects.scenario: Build a driver earnings summary page for a Bolt driver. Use JavaScript to display earnings data, update trip stats, manage status badges, and toggle alert messages.
requirements: Select the element with id 'driver-name' and update its textContent to a driver name
Use querySelector to select '.earnings-total' and update its textContent to '₦32,400 net earnings'
Use element.style to set the width of id 'rating-bar' to '92%' and backgroundColor to '#ffc107'
Use setAttribute to set 'data-week' on id 'summary-card' to 'Week 4 — Jan 2025'; log with getAttribute
Use querySelectorAll to select all '.trip-row' elements; log the count and use forEach to log each row's textContent
Use classList.add to add class 'gold' to the element with id 'rating-badge'
Use classList.toggle 'hidden' on id 'bonus-alert'; log whether it contains 'hidden' after the toggle
Use Array.from on the trip rows and filter to keep rows whose textContent includes 'completed'; log the filtered count

descriptors.full: getElementById and querySelector/querySelectorAll used correctly; nested querySelector used on a specific element; NodeList length logged
descriptors.partial: Selection methods used but one or more missing or incorrect (e.g., querySelector used where querySelectorAll needed)
descriptors.none: Selection methods absent or all returning null due to incorrect selectors

descriptors.full: textContent and innerHTML used correctly; setAttribute and getAttribute used for at least one attribute; inline style set with correct camelCase property names
descriptors.partial: Two of the three techniques used correctly; one missing or incorrectly applied
descriptors.none: Content and attribute modification absent or using incorrect APIs

descriptors.full: classList.add, remove, and toggle all used; NodeList iterated with forEach; Array.from used to enable filter; filter result logged correctly
descriptors.partial: classList operations present but toggle or Array.from missing; forEach works but filter absent
descriptors.none: classList and NodeList iteration both missing or non-functional

descriptors.full: const/let used correctly, variable names are descriptive, output is clear and readable, no var
descriptors.partial: Minor quality issues — occasional let where const fits, unclear variable names
descriptors.none: var used, unclear naming, or output is unreadable
